meta.about: Every new string of the set-up flow, the four-gun HUD and the new guns, attachments, crew and levels (docs/unreal/LOADOUT.md 2.11). Keyed as it will sit in text.json under `frontend`; kept in its own file because text.json is written by tools/ue-export from the web game and a hand edit there would be overwritten. The loader reads both; a key of this file never shadows a key of text.json.
meta.encoding: a string with {name} parameters is a template, written as in text.json: {"$template": {template, params, example}}
meta.voice: the game's own: short, street, second person, no real makes or models, no real people other than the star

effects.about: One line per effect, built from the data: {mark} is ▲ when the change is better and ▼ when it is worse (• for a neutral line), {sign} is + or −, {pct} the whole-number percentage change, {value} the new value and {base} the gun's own. The line is also green when better and red when worse (the stat's `better` in attachments.json); the glyph carries the meaning without colour.

glyphs.about: Key and button names drawn next to the controls they work, for the device the player used last: kbm (keyboard and mouse), pad, touch (none). weapon3 to wheel: the HUD's four-slot bar; back to panes: the set-up screens' bottom bar and hints (LOADOUT.md 2.2).

controls.about: Rows added to the Controls drawer (text.json interface.controls), after Swap weapon. The wheel rows show only when three or more guns are carried.
